# revolvedSilhouetteBbox

## Summary

Decides which region of the reference to trace as THE object's revolved silhouette, or why not to trace at all. It unions the bboxes of the analysis plan's `revolved` parts, then enforces two conditions: the parts must share one axis (checked pairwise — each pair must overlap by at least 60% of the narrower width), and the union must BE the body (at least 60% of the object's height and 50% of its width), so a single round detail like a drum magazine cannot hand its outline to the whole object. Returns `{ bbox }` or `{ skipped: reason }`.

## Import

```ts
import { revolvedSilhouetteBbox } from '../util/silhouette';
```

## Usage

The studio (`components/studio-isolated.gts`) calls it with the analysis part plan; a returned bbox goes to `traceLatheProfile`, and a `skipped` reason is logged instead of tracing.
